method: Read Zoho CRM's own pricing page in a US-locale (en-US, America/New_York) headless browser, capturing both the Monthly and Annually toggle states with the FAQ expanded, and its full feature-comparison page with every row expanded (the only page that shows Ultimate, which has no card on the main pricing page). Also checked the India-locale URL path directly. Every price on every capture was explicitly prefixed 'US$'. Snapshots saved.

freeTier.summary: Free for up to 3 users, no credit card required: contact/lead/deal management, follow-up reminders, workflow automation, 10 custom email templates, tasks/meetings/calls, data import/export, standard reports, APIs and mobile apps. Capped at 5,000 records (10MB) of storage, and has no Mass Email (bulk/marketing send) feature, which starts at Standard.

trial.summary: 15-day free trial, no credit card required, offered on Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Ultimate (each has its own 'Free Trial' / 'Try Now' button).

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Hard-capped at 3 users; there is no way to add a 4th user on this edition.
limits: No Mass Email (bulk/marketing send) feature - Standard and above only
highlights: Contact/lead/deal management, workflow automation, tasks/meetings/calls, data import/export, standard reports, APIs, mobile apps

plans.name: Standard
plans.note: US$20/user/month paid month-to-month, or US$14/user/month billed annually (US$168/user/year). No cap on number of users (the 3-user cap is Free-only).
limits: Mass Email capped at 250/day per organization (about 7,500/month)
5 profiles, 5 roles, 20 groups, 10 custom modules, 100 custom email templates

plans.name: Professional
plans.note: US$35/user/month paid month-to-month, or US$23/user/month billed annually (US$276/user/year). Zoho's 'Most Popular' edition.
limits: Mass Email capped at 500/day per organization (about 15,000/month)
highlights: Inventory management (products, quotes, sales orders, invoices)
CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), custom portals, customer journeys

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: US$50/user/month paid month-to-month, or US$40/user/month billed annually (US$480/user/year).
limits: Mass Email capped at 1,000/day per organization (about 30,000/month)
Lite User seats available at US$15/month month-to-month or US$12/month billed annually
highlights: Custom buttons & functions, extended field types
Sequential data collection, approval process, Account-Based Marketing

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.note: US$65/user/month paid month-to-month, or US$52/user/month billed annually (US$624/user/year). Not shown as a card on the main pricing page (only Free, Standard, Professional and Enterprise are); listed on Zoho's feature-comparison page with its own self-serve 'Try Now' trial. Zoho's FAQ describes it as 'tailored for large-scale, bespoke deployments ... with consultation with experts and migration assistance.'
limits: Mass Email capped at 2,000/day per organization (about 60,000/month) - the highest Zoho CRM tier, still short of very high-volume sending needs
Lite User seats available at US$15/month month-to-month or US$12/month billed annually
highlights: Highest feature limits across the board (API/function credits, sandboxes, security controls)

addOns.name: Lite User license (Enterprise/Ultimate)
addOns.unit: per user per month, billed annually (US$15/user/month paid month-to-month)
addOns.note: A limited-access seat type cheaper than a full user license. Not available on Free, Standard or Professional.

addOns.name: Additional file storage
addOns.unit: per 5GB per month, for the whole organization
addOns.note: Not available on Free. Same US$4.60/5GB rate on every paid edition.

addOns.name: Additional data storage (organizations with 1-200 users)
addOns.unit: per 100MB per month, for the whole organization
addOns.note: Not available on Free or Standard. Drops to US$2 per 100MB/month for organizations with more than 200 users.

extraCosts.label: Local taxes
extraCosts.note: Stated once on the pricing page without a rate or list of countries.

extraCosts.label: On-demand data backup request
extraCosts.note: Available on every edition, including Free. Free backups included each month: none on Free, 2 on Standard/Professional/Enterprise, 4 on Ultimate; additional requests cost US$12 each.

billingNotes: Zoho CRM is pay-as-you-go with no contracts: pay monthly or yearly, and change plans at any time (Zoho's own FAQ wording).

Annual billing is the default view on the pricing page and costs 20-34% less per seat than paying month-to-month, depending on plan (Standard: US$14 vs US$20/user/month; Professional: US$23 vs US$35; Enterprise: US$40 vs US$50; Ultimate: US$52 vs US$65).
Accepted payment: Visa, MasterCard, American Express and PayPal; yearly subscriptions can also be paid by bank transfer or check.
Local taxes may apply on top of the listed prices.

Ultimate is not shown as a card on the main pricing page (only Free, Standard, Professional and Enterprise are); its price and features are listed only on Zoho's feature-comparison page, where it still offers a self-serve 'Try Now' free trial.

regional.note: We found no evidence that Zoho CRM's pricing page shows a different currency by country: the plain pricing URL redirects to the /en-us/ path and every price on every capture is explicitly prefixed 'US$' (not a bare '$' or '₹'), and a direct request for an /en-in/ locale path returned a 404 rather than an India-priced page. We did not test IP-based geolocation from other countries, so this reflects the paths and locale we could reach, not an exhaustive check.

scenarios.label: Solo operator, 1 seat, on Standard
scenarios.assumptions: 1 user, 1,000 contacts, 2,000 marketing emails and 200 SMS a month. Free is ruled out because it has no Mass Email (bulk send) feature at all; Standard adds it with a cap of 250 mass emails/day per organization (about 7,500/month over 30 days), which comfortably covers 2,000/month. 1,000 contacts is far under Standard's 100,000-record storage cap. Zoho CRM has no native SMS/texting feature on its pricing or feature-comparison pages, so the 200 SMS/month cannot be priced and are not included (see unverified).

lines.label: Zoho CRM Standard, 1 user at US$20/user/month, paid month-to-month

scenarios.note: Billed annually the same seat is US$14/month (US$168/year) instead of US$20/month (US$240/year) paid month-to-month.

scenarios.label: 3-person team, 3 seats, on Enterprise (forced by mass-email volume)
scenarios.assumptions: 3 users, 5,000 contacts, 20,000 marketing emails and 1,000 SMS a month. Org-wide Mass Email caps, extended to a month at 30 days, are Standard 250/day (about 7,500/month) and Professional 500/day (about 15,000/month) - both short of 20,000/month. Enterprise's 1,000/day (about 30,000/month) is the first tier that covers it. 3 seats and 5,000 contacts are both far under Enterprise's other limits regardless. Zoho CRM has no native SMS feature, so the 1,000 SMS/month cannot be priced and are not included (see unverified).

lines.label: Zoho CRM Enterprise, 3 users at US$50/user/month, paid month-to-month

scenarios.note: Billed annually the same 3 seats are US$40/user/month (US$120/month, US$1,440/year) instead of US$150/month (US$1,800/year) paid month-to-month. If 20,000 mass emails/month were spread unevenly and effectively fit within Professional's roughly 15,000/month published cap, Professional at US$35/user/month (US$105/month for 3 seats) would be cheaper; we picked Enterprise because 20,000/month is the layer's stated assumption and exceeds Professional's published cap.

scenarios.label: 8-person team, 8 seats, on Ultimate (mass-email volume exceeds every edition's cap)
scenarios.assumptions: 8 users, 25,000 contacts, 100,000 marketing emails and 5,000 SMS a month. Ultimate is the highest self-serve edition, and its org-wide Mass Email cap (2,000/day, about 60,000/month over 30 days) is still short of the 100,000/month assumption for this layer - no Zoho CRM edition's published limit reaches 100,000/month. Ultimate is used here as the best available fit; reaching 100,000/month natively would need a separate product or a support-approved limit increase not published on these pages (Zoho's own FAQ points large deployments toward migration/consultation services). 8 seats and 25,000 contacts are both far under Ultimate's other limits. Zoho CRM has no native SMS feature, so the 5,000 SMS/month cannot be priced and are not included (see unverified).

lines.label: Zoho CRM Ultimate, 8 users at US$65/user/month, paid month-to-month

scenarios.note: Billed annually the same 8 seats are US$52/user/month (US$416/month, US$4,992/year) instead of US$520/month (US$6,240/year) paid month-to-month. Enterprise and Ultimate both offer a cheaper Lite User seat (US$12/month annual, US$15/month monthly) for team members who only need limited CRM access, which could lower this line if not all 8 need full seats; not applied here because the layer's standard sizing does not distinguish seat types. Confidence is low because no edition's published mass-email limit actually reaches the 100,000/month assumed for this scenario.

unverified: Zoho CRM does not list a native SMS/texting feature or per-SMS rate on its pricing or feature-comparison pages; the standard 200/1,000/5,000-SMS-per-month assumptions used for this layer's scenarios are not reflected in any scenario line.

No Zoho CRM edition's published Mass Email cap reaches 100,000 emails/month (Ultimate's is about 60,000/month); what it would actually cost to send 100,000/month (a different Zoho product, or a support-approved limit increase) is not published.
Additional Portal user license pricing is referenced ('Pricing for additional portal user licenses') on the feature-comparison page, but no figure is shown there.

Whether Zoho shows non-USD pricing (e.g. INR) to visitors it detects as being outside the US: we saw only 'US$'-prefixed prices, the bare pricing URL redirected to the /en-us/ path, and a direct /en-in/ path returned a 404; we did not test IP-based geolocation from other countries directly.
